limitations: Retrospective official archive captures do not eliminate model-weight hindsight or prove the exact contemporaneous byte state. No historical trading edge or predictive score is claimed.
Regional totals and reclassification amounts are published rounded Bcf. Implied physical flow is a storage-accounting inference, not an independent measurement of every pipeline movement.
The 14-day scenario is synthetic; fixed baseline flows and unconstrained one-for-one demand effects omit price response, deliverability and capacity constraints.
Independent calculation review is recorded in docs/expansion-review-record.md; commodity-domain expert acceptance remains pending.
